1.title: Introduction to Next.js
1.explanation: Next.js is a React framework used to build fast, scalable web applications. It provides file-based routing, server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and API routes.
1.practice: Create a Home page that displays your name and a short welcome message.
1.quiz: What JavaScript library is Next.js built on?

2.title: Pages and Routing
2.explanation: Each file inside the pages (or app) directory automatically becomes a route in your application.
2.output: Opening /about displays the About Us page.
2.practice: Create a contact page and access it through its route.

3.title: API Routes
3.explanation: Next.js can create backend API endpoints inside the project, allowing frontend and backend code to live together.
3.practice: Create an API route that returns your name and country in JSON format.
3.quiz: What is the purpose of an API route in Next.js?
